description: This Kotlin source file defines the CategoriesFragment class for an Android app, which manages the display and manipulation of category lists, including adding, renaming, and deleting categories with user interactions and dialogs.

classes.name: CategoriesFragment
classes.description: An Android Fragment that displays a list of categories and allows the user to add, delete, or rename categories.

methods.name: onAttach
methods.description: Binds the fragment to the context, checking for the CategorySelectionListener interface and initializing the repository.

methods.name: onDetach
methods.description: Detaches the fragment from its context, nullifying the listener.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the fragment layout, sets up the RecyclerView and adapter, and configures the add button.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Refreshes the category list when the fragment becomes active.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Reloads the categories from the repository and updates the UI.

methods.name: promptAddCategory
methods.description: Displays a dialog prompting the user to input a new category name, then inserts it into the repository.

methods.name: showCategoryOptionsDialog
methods.description: Shows options to rename or delete a selected category.

methods.name: promptRenameCategory
methods.description: Displays a dialog to input a new name for an existing category and updates it.
